text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ That crepe was so fluffy and 
delicious! No wonder it's Air Groove's top 
recommendation~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am glad it suited your palate. Now then, 
for our next plan, we shall head to the 
aquarium together to see the dolphin show—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Aahh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
?! Mother! Where are you going?! 
Mother...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Where on earth did Mother go...? She 
certainly ran into this park...

text_block_list.name: Little Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah~! Amazing! I ran just like you told 
me, and I didn't fall at all! Hey, hey, I 
wanna run even faster!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you gotta run alongside 
someone fast! For today, I'll be your 
opponent—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Mother! If you need a running 
partner, I am right here!

text_block_list.name: Little Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah! The sun is setting! I have to go home!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're right, it's already 
evening—...Evening?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Whoops~ Did I do it again...! Sorry, Air 
Groove! The aquarium is probably closed by 
now...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, pay it no mind. Let us skip that 
schedule and proceed to the next location.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a night view! So pretty! Oho~ 
To think you knew about a place like this, 
you really are something!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you always loved high places, 
Mother. ...I am glad to see your spirits 
restored.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: ! ...Well, I don't know what to say.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I-Is something the matter...? Did I make 
some kind of blunder...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that's not it at all! I was just 
thinking what a truly dependable daughter 
you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You've helped me so much since you were 
little. Remember back then, when I was 
busy, you looked after your two younger 
sisters.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You were always so dependable. Well, I 
guess I forced you to become 
dependable—though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... If you had a different mother, I 
wonder what kind of child you would have 
grown into?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? ...Wait, don't make such a scary 
face! It's a joke, a joke! Just a "what 
if" thought—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even as a joke! Please do not ever say 
such a thing again!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Mother, do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not just racecourses, but events, 
festivals— You took me to all kinds of 
places and allowed me to experience so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can adapt flexibly to 
any petition brought to the student 
council. And of course—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter how disadvantaged I may be, I 
believe in my victory and give everything 
until the very end. The reason I can 
maintain such pride—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is precisely because I picture you running 
with unwavering resolve... and prevailing 
in fierce battles.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What I inherited from you, what you taught 
me— if even one part were missing, I 
wouldn't be who I am.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is why I am your daughter. Always 
have been, and always will be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
.........Um... ...I apologize for suddenly 
raising my voice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm the one who should apologize. I 
shouldn't have said that, even as a joke. 
And also—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad that you... that you are my 
daughter!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Because—ever since the day you were born, 
you've always taught me so many things 
too... and brought a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way home after finishing work, I 
happened to spot Air Groove looking rather 
high-spirited.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: 'I'm glad you are my daughter', huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... With this surge of emotion— the 
moon looks remarkably beautiful tonight.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... With this surge of emotion— the 
moon looks remarkably beautiful tonight.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... It's you. Tell me, do you express 
your gratitude to those important to you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If not, you should make a conscious effort 
to do so. It is easy to forget, but those 
closest to us are the ones who support us 
the most.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you. ...Yes, it is a fine night. 
Almost too much of a waste to spend it 
sleeping. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she looked up at the night sky, Air 
Groove's gaze seemed to be filled with 
endless tenderness.
